verdict.rationale: Weave documents automatic versioning of traced functions, datasets, and evaluation objects (weave.op(), Evaluation objects) and provides alert/webhook 'automations' for production signals, but there is no evidence of a review or rollback mechanism for these automations/versions. Missing for 10: explicit rollback UI/API for automations, version-history browsing/restore workflow, and evidence tying versioning to the alert/webhook automations themselves.
